cohort: Women who presented with a life-threatening condition during pregnancy, childbirth, or within 42 days of termination of their pregnancy at Port Moresby General Hospital over a 15-month period.
finding: The study determined a maternal near-miss index ratio of 9.1/1000 live births, with obstetric haemorrhage, hypertensive disorders, and infections being the main causes, and grandmultiparity, nulliparity, no antenatal attendance, and age beyond 30 years associated factors.
